messages:
anjali: quick notes from today's micro-ablation on rwd-7b-spec. tried KL-gating + prefix-temp-anneal approach. dataset = 1k conversational prompts (mix of short/long).
tom: KL-gating? give me the gist.
anjali: after spec-window=6, compute token-KL between spec and verifier across window. if KL > 0.04 -> run verifier (fp16) on next 12 tokens. prefix-temp-anneal reduces softmax temp on first 3 spec tokens to 0.9 -> 0.8 -> 0.7 to reduce overconfident rare-token pulls.
viv: did that reduce false-positives (unnecessary fallbacks)?
anjali: yes, verifier invocation dropped ~22% vs plain logprob-threshold baseline, regen rate steady at 0.6%. throughput +1.3x. median latency -18ms, p99 unchanged.
tom: any quality regressions? human spot-check 40 examples?
anjali: 40 checks: 1 mild truncation, 2 stylistic tone shifts, no factual regressions. token-rare usage stable.
viv: infra? anything odd?
anjali: small scheduler hiccup at T+00:05 (node eviction) but removed from traces. scored traces uploaded s3://rwd-spec/1749999990/trace.tar.gz
ops-bot: canary deploy request queued (user: anjali).
anjali: next steps: run 3x larger eval (5k prompts), compare KL-gate thresholds [0.02,0.04,0.06], and try verifier on cpu for small batches to cut cost. will open notebook with results. :mag:
